rationale: Greek σπήλαιον 'cave, chamber.' Listed as the second architectural feature of the sensory φύσις after houses (ⲏⲓ̈) and before treasuries (ⲁⲡⲟⲫⲏⲕⲏ). Likely an inner storage-cavity within the cosmological/psychological house-structure.
Coptic ϣⲁϩ — 'shaft, hollow.' Fourth architectural element in the inventory ⲏⲓ̈ / ⲥⲡⲧⲏⲗⲁ / ⲁⲡⲟⲫⲏⲕⲏ / ϣⲁϩ. The deepest internal storage-locus within the sensory faculty.
Greek αἰτητής 'one who asks.' The figure who requests retrieval of a stored impression from the sensory faculty. Paired with ⲡⲣⲉϩϣⲓⲛⲉ 'the inquirer' (compound) as the requesting agent.
Greek (ἐπι)θυμία 'desire, lust.' Listed alongside love (ⲙⲉⲓ̈ⲉ) and hate (ⲙⲁⲥⲧⲉ) as one of the affective qualities a stored impression can have.

proposed_english: drawn in heart / inclined of heart
rationale: ⲏⲕ qualitative + ⲛ̄ⲍⲏⲧ 'of heart.' Idiomatic phrase for the faculty being drawn/inclined toward retrieving a stored impression. The internal motion-of-attention preceding retrieval.

proposed_english: to do likewise / do in the same manner
rationale: ⲣ̄- ('do') + ⲧⲍⲉ (Lyc. ⲧⲉⲓϩⲉ 'this manner') = verbal idiom 'do in this manner, do likewise.' Iterative-typological formula structuring the parallel descriptions of eyes, ears, and smell.

ⲙⲁⲛ- ('place of') + ϣⲱⲗⲙ ('smell'). The olfactory faculty named in the same compound pattern as ⲙⲁⲛⲥⲱⲧⲙⲉ 'place of hearing.' Direct cosmological-correspondential designation: the bodily organ IS the cosmic place where the corresponding sensation occurs.
ⲙⲁⲛ- ('place of') + ⲥⲱⲧⲙ ('hear'). Pair-partner with ⲙⲁⲛϣⲱⲗⲙⲉ. The auditory faculty as cosmic locus.

Compound ⲣⲉϥ- ('one who') + ϣⲓⲛⲉ ('ask, inquire') = 'inquirer, questioner.' Standard agentive formation paralleling ⲣⲉϩ†ⲥⲃⲱ 'teacher.' The petitioning figure who requests retrieval of stored sensory impressions.

Verbal noun ⲣ̄- + ⲡⲙⲉⲩⲉ ('thought') = 'the remembering / the remembrance.' Built on the second of the five faculties (per glossary). Designates the retrieved impression as it is delivered back from storage to the petitioner.

Coptic ⲥⲧⲟⲓ 'smell, odor.' Object of the olfactory faculty's storage operation; cf. ⲧⲉⲥⲧⲉ 'scent' already in glossary (related root). Singular here in the iterative phrase 'every scent that she smells.'
